title: 区域多 LoRA（分区域布局）

standard.summary: 在画面上划分区域，每个区域绑一个 LoRA 与局部提示词。
standard.effect: 每个区域的 LoRA 残差只作用在自己的框内，框外恰好为零；同时在采样的每一步把注意力往各自的框里拉。留空即关闭，此时渲染与不开启逐位相同。
standard.whenToUse: 一张图里要同时出现两个及以上各自训练过的角色或概念，直接叠加多个 LoRA 会互相污染时。
standard.avoidWhen: 只有一个 LoRA，或各概念本来就不需要固定位置时。区域会带来每步一次额外前向的开销。

standard_en.summary: Divides the canvas into regions and binds a LoRA and a local prompt to each one.
standard_en.effect: Each region's LoRA residual acts only inside its own box and is exactly zero outside it; at the same time, attention is pulled towards each box at every sampling step. Leave it blank to disable, in which case rendering is bit-for-bit identical to not enabling it.
standard_en.whenToUse: When two or more separately trained characters or concepts have to appear in one image and simply stacking several LoRAs contaminates them.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When there is only one LoRA, or when the concepts do not need fixed positions anyway. Regions cost one extra forward pass per step.

advanced.principle: 区域感知的多 LoRA 组合（arXiv:2403.11627）。布局由归一化到 [0,1] 的框给出，框在 patchified token 网格上栅格化成掩码，用于门控该区域 LoRA 的残差；每一步再按 Eq. 10 用注意力约束损失的梯度修正 latent，把概念约束在框内。
advanced.intervention: 填入 JSON 数组，每项形如 {"box": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "lora": "路径", "prompt": "局部提示词", "token_index": 1}。坐标必须是 [0,1] 归一化值，像素坐标会被直接拒绝。出图页的画框工具会替你生成这段 JSON。
advanced.expectedImpact: 各概念留在自己的区域内，不再互相串味。
advanced.tradeoffs: 约束需要对 latent 求梯度，每个采样步多一次前向，步时约 2 倍。

advanced_en.principle: Region-aware multi-LoRA composition (arXiv:2403.11627). The layout is given by boxes normalized to [0,1], rasterized into masks on the patchified token grid to gate that region's LoRA residual; each step then corrects the latents with gradients of an attention-constraint loss per Eq. 10, confining concepts to their boxes.
advanced_en.intervention: Fill in a JSON array, each item shaped like {"box": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "lora": "path", "prompt": "local prompt", "token_index": 1}. Coordinates must be [0,1]-normalized values; pixel coordinates are rejected outright. The bounding-box tool on the image page generates this JSON for you.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Each concept stays in its own region instead of bleeding into the others.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The constraint needs gradients against the latents, one extra forward per sampling step, roughly doubling step time.
